facts.fact: The analysis states that Articles 262 to 270 of the Digital Code provide for the Autorité de Protection des Données, to be set up by Prime Ministerial decree, and that a ministerial order of 17 August 2024 (n° CAB/MIN/PT&N/AKIM/KL/KBS/051/2024) provisionally transferred its missions to ARPTIC pending its establishment; the document does not say ARPTIC has acted in that role.
